title: Conditions for NR sidelink communication operation

entities.name: NR sidelink communication operation
entities.description: The procedure for NR sidelink communication that the UE shall perform only when specific conditions are met.

entities.name: Condition 1: Suitable serving cell and PLMN/out-of-coverage
entities.description: UE's serving cell is suitable (RRC_IDLE, RRC_INACTIVE, or RRC_CONNECTED) and either the selected cell on the sidelink frequency belongs to registered/equivalent PLMN or UE is out of coverage on sidelink frequency.

entities.name: Condition 2: Limited service state support and frequency/out-of-coverage
entities.description: UE's serving cell (RRC_IDLE or RRC_CONNECTED) supports NR sidelink communication in limited service state and either serving cell is on sidelink frequency or UE is out of coverage on sidelink frequency.

entities.name: Condition 3: No serving cell
entities.description: UE has no serving cell (RRC_IDLE state).

entities.name: RRC_IDLE
entities.description: RRC idle state of the UE.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE
entities.description: RRC inactive state of the UE.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: RRC connected state of the UE.

entities.name: Out of coverage on sidelink frequency
entities.description: UE is out of coverage on the frequency used for NR sidelink communication operation as defined in TS 38.304 and TS 36.304.

relations.description: NR sidelink communication operation requires Condition 1 to be met.
NR sidelink communication operation requires Condition 2 to be met.
NR sidelink communication operation requires Condition 3 to be met.
Condition 1 requires RRC_IDLE state as one possible serving cell state.
Condition 1 requires RRC_INACTIVE state as one possible serving cell state.
Condition 1 requires RRC_CONNECTED state as one possible serving cell state.
Condition 1 includes the possibility that UE is out of coverage on sidelink frequency.
Condition 2 requires RRC_IDLE state as one possible serving cell state.
Condition 2 requires RRC_CONNECTED state as one possible serving cell state.
Condition 2 includes the possibility that UE is out of coverage on sidelink frequency.
Condition 3 requires RRC_IDLE state when UE has no serving cell.
